// @vitest-environment jsdom
// Drives an OLDER build's real store code (this file is copied into that build's tests/ folder, as
// julianRangeDrive.dom.test.jsx) over storage as Round 26 leaves it — the Julian-on Year Range in a
// per-preset key of its own (`cg-julianrange-v1[~pN]`) and riding in a saved-defaults snapshot as two
// extra settings keys — and writes down what the older build left (run with OLDER_BUILD=<tag>
// JULIAN_OUT=<file>). The record is tests/fixtures/olderBuilds/julianRange-<build>.json;
// tests/julianRange.olderBuilds.test.js holds this build to it.
//
// The older builds know the settings blob as its 16 fields and a preset as four keys. Each case is
// one row of design-q7-q10's interleaving table (A2.3), done the way the older build's own panel
// does it: a store write through the same action its handler calls.
import { it, afterAll } from 'vitest'
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { usePresets } from '../src/store/presets.js'
import { useSettings, SETTINGS_DEFAULTS } from '../src/store/settings.js'
import { useModePrefs } from '../src/store/modePrefs.js'
import { useProgress } from '../src/store/progress.js'
import { useUserDefaults, effectiveSettingsDefaults } from '../src/store/userDefaults.js'
import { deletePreset, isPresetFactory } from '../src/store/presetControl.js'

const BUILD = process.env.OLDER_BUILD
const out = {}
const JR = 'cg-julianrange-v1'
const SETTINGS = 'cg-settings-v1'
const PROGRESS = 'cg-progress-v1'
const DEFAULTS = 'cg-userdefaults-v1'
const REGISTRY = 'cg-presets-v1'
const NEW_SETTINGS = { ...SETTINGS_DEFAULTS, dotRotation: 'standard', defaultMode: 'classic' }
// Settings as this build saves them: the 16 values, version 4 (fields an older build lacks are
// simply ones it does not know).
const settingsBlob = (values) => JSON.stringify({ state: { ...NEW_SETTINGS, ...values }, version: 4 })
const pairBlob = (julianMinY, julianMaxY) =>
  JSON.stringify({ state: { julianMinY, julianMaxY }, version: 1 })
const registryBlob = (ids) =>
  JSON.stringify({
    state: {
      presets: ids.map((id) => ({ id, name: `Preset ${id}`, amnesic: false })),
      activeId: 1,
      nextId: Math.max(...ids) + 1,
      openInPreset: 'last',
    },
    version: 1,
  })
const AOX_1_10000 = '10|false|written-mdy|random|random|random|1-10000|true'
const REC = { avg: 1.5, avgMed: 1.5, avgRoundId: 7, med: 1.5, medAvg: 1.5, medRoundId: 7 }

// A page load of the older build: every store reads storage again (the settings store first, as
// every build orders it). A store whose saved version differs migrates and re-saves at once.
async function pageLoad() {
  for (const s of [usePresets, useSettings, useModePrefs, useProgress, useUserDefaults])
    await s.persist.rehydrate()
}
const dump = () =>
  Object.fromEntries(
    Array.from({ length: localStorage.length }, (_, i) => localStorage.key(i))
      .sort()
      .map((k) => [k, JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k))]),
  )
async function run(name, seed, act) {
  localStorage.clear()
  sessionStorage.clear()
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(seed)) localStorage.setItem(k, v)
  await pageLoad()
  const extra = (await act()) ?? null
  out[name] = { after: dump(), extra }
}

it('row 1: the Julian-on pair set to 1-10000, then a theme change and Reset Settings here', async () => {
  await run(
    'row1',
    {
      [SETTINGS]: settingsBlob({ useJulian: true }),
      [JR]: pairBlob(1, 10000),
      [PROGRESS]: JSON.stringify({ state: { aoxBest: { [AOX_1_10000]: REC } }, version: 5 }),
    },
    () => {
      useSettings.getState().setUseSystem(false)
      useSettings.getState().setManualTheme('nebula')
      useSettings.getState().applySettings(effectiveSettingsDefaults(useUserDefaults.getState().saved))
    },
  )
})
it('row 2: with Julian on, the range edited here to 1500-1700', async () => {
  await run('row2', { [SETTINGS]: settingsBlob({ useJulian: true }), [JR]: pairBlob(1, 11582) }, () => {
    useSettings.getState().setMinY(1500)
    useSettings.getState().setMaxY(1700)
  })
})
it('row 4: merely opened', async () => {
  await run(
    'row4',
    { [SETTINGS]: settingsBlob({ useJulian: true, minY: 1900, maxY: 2100 }), [JR]: pairBlob(5, 11000) },
    () => undefined,
  )
})
it('row 5: a preset deleted here', async () => {
  await run(
    'row5',
    {
      [REGISTRY]: registryBlob([1, 2]),
      [`${SETTINGS}~p2`]: settingsBlob({ minY: 1900, maxY: 2100 }),
      [`${JR}~p2`]: pairBlob(1900, 2100),
    },
    () => ({ deleted: deletePreset(2) }),
  )
})
it('row 6: is a preset whose only change is its Julian-on pair untouched, to this build?', async () => {
  await run(
    'row6',
    { [REGISTRY]: registryBlob([1, 2]), [`${JR}~p2`]: pairBlob(1, 10000) },
    () => ({ factory: isPresetFactory(2, true) }),
  )
})
const PREFS = { flashMs: 800, blitzSec: 60, blitzQSec: 10, aoxN: '10' }
const savedBlob = (settings) =>
  JSON.stringify({
    state: { saved: { settings, prefs: PREFS, amnesic: false, amnesicMode: 'off' } },
    version: 3,
  })
// What the older build's panel hands saveDefaults for the Amnesic value it passes through.
const amnesicOf = (saved) => (BUILD === 'v2.26.0' ? (saved?.amnesic ?? false) : 'off')
it('row 8: saved defaults edited here, in the defaults manager', async () => {
  await run(
    'row8',
    { [DEFAULTS]: savedBlob({ ...NEW_SETTINGS, minY: 1500, maxY: 1600, julianMinY: 2, julianMaxY: 11000 }) },
    () => {
      const saved = useUserDefaults.getState().saved
      // components/SettingsPanel's commitManageDefaults, in every one of these builds:
      useUserDefaults.getState().saveDefaults({
        settings: saved ? saved.settings : SETTINGS_DEFAULTS,
        prefs: { ...PREFS, flashMs: 900 },
        amnesic: amnesicOf(saved),
      })
    },
  )
})
it('row 9: Save Defaults pressed here', async () => {
  await run(
    'row9',
    {
      [SETTINGS]: settingsBlob({ minY: 1500, maxY: 1600 }),
      [DEFAULTS]: savedBlob({ ...NEW_SETTINGS, julianMinY: 2, julianMaxY: 11000 }),
    },
    () => {
      // components/SettingsPanel's openSaveDefaults + commitSaveDefaults: the live 16, as this build
      // knows them.
      const s = useSettings.getState()
      const settings = Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(SETTINGS_DEFAULTS).map((k) => [k, s[k]]))
      useUserDefaults.getState().saveDefaults({
        settings,
        prefs: PREFS,
        amnesic: amnesicOf(useUserDefaults.getState().saved),
      })
    },
  )
})

afterAll(() => {
  writeFileSync(process.env.JULIAN_OUT, JSON.stringify({ build: BUILD, ...out }, null, 2) + '\n')
})
